title: Red powder fire extinguisher with hose and label
objects_and_counts: One red cylindrical fire extinguisher is visible, shown in full height and upright.
One black flexible hose is attached to the left side of the extinguisher and is visible from near the top down to the base; the hose is not cropped.
One pressure gauge is visible at the top assembly next to the handle; the gauge face is visible and not cropped.
One red metal handle / lever assembly is visible at the top of the extinguisher.
One black rubber or plastic base is fitted around the bottom of the extinguisher and is fully visible.
Multiple printed pictogram panels and instruction labels are visible on the front face of the extinguisher; these are part of the photographed scene, not separate posters or screens.
No people are visible in the image.
visible_text: For use on all fires (Classes A, B & C) except metal fires
Aim nozzle at base of fire
spatial_relations: The main instruction label with the word 'Powder' is centered on the front face of the cylinder.
The black hose runs up the left side of the cylinder from the base to the top valve assembly and then curves outward to the left of the handle.
The pressure gauge is mounted at the top of the cylinder adjacent to the red handle/lever; the handle extends to the right and up from the valve assembly.
Pictogram instruction boxes are arranged vertically on the front label beneath the 'FIRE EXTINGUISHER' heading.
The black base encircles the bottom of the red cylinder and rests beneath the front label area.
colours_and_materials: The extinguisher body is glossy red.
The hose is black and appears to be a flexible rubber or rubber-like material.
The base is black and appears to be rubber or hard plastic.
The valve assembly and connector area include a metallic (brass-coloured) fitting beneath the gauge.
The handle/lever is painted red metal, matching the cylinder colour.
uncertainties: Smaller caution and manufacturer text near the bottom and on the right side of the label is not legible in the image and is represented as '[unreadable]'.
The exact spacing, punctuation or line breaks of some multi-line instruction blocks may be partially obscured by reflections; transcriptions for those lines are the best readable rendering.
The short code '43A 233B C' was transcribed as visible, but minute characters around it are small and could contain additional marks that are not legible.
Manufacturer/address text below 'COMMANDER' is too small to read reliably in this image and was therefore not transcribed.
